answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded issuance plus scarce, slashable sponsorship. A new agent becomes eligible only after locking collateral through a multi-epoch horizon; early withdrawal or a later clustering proof slashes that bond. Each established agent may sponsor only a tiny intake each close — a willow of recruits — and unused slots expire, so they cannot be stockpiled. An attacker who wants a timber pile of fake identities must post one lock per shell and also capture many uncorrelated sponsors. The marginal fake is priced in locked capital and scarce endorsements, not free sign-ups.
